data.live_tip-audience_shortage-01|descriptio:
It seems your Audience size is low. Raise your Idols'
Fan Count and Core Fan Rate through Work.
data.live_tip-audience_shortage-02|descriptio:
It seems your Audience size is low. The larger the Audience, the bigger
the Score bonus, and the lower the chance of failing Skills.
data.live_tip-deck_unbalance-01|description:
It seems you have too many Scorer Types. Outside the SP Skill
positions, balance your Supporters and Buffers.
data.live_tip-deck_unbalance-02|description:
It seems you have too many Scorer Types. Supporter
Types on the outside and Buffer Types in other positions are recommended.
data.live_tip-in_cool_time-01|description:
It seems A Skills aren't activating well in positions with many A Skill chances.
Place Idols with a short A Skill CT (cooldown).
data.live_tip-in_cool_time-02|description:
It seems A Skills aren't activating well in positions with many A Skill chances.
If you have an Idol with 2 A Skills, try placing them.
data.live_tip-in_cool_time-03|description:
If A Skills don't activate, the combo breaks and your Score won't grow.
Check the lane info and A Skill CT, and place your Idols properly.
data.live_tip-level_shortage-01|description:
It seems your Idols' levels aren't high enough for the Live difficulty.
Level up your Idols with "Idol Strengthening".
data.live_tip-low_activating_rate-01|descript:
It seems your opponent is taking many Skill Chances. In each
lane, the Idol with the highest stats gains the right to activate Skills.
data.live_tip-low_activating_rate-02|descript:
It seems your opponent is taking many Skill Chances.
Stamina recovery can be effective for stealing chances.
data.live_tip-miss-01|description:
It seems your Skills are failing.
Compensate for Mental with Sub Accessories and Photos.
data.live_tip-miss-02|description:
It seems your Skills are failing.
Increase the Audience size and Mental to reduce Skill failures.
data.live_tip-not_possessed-01|description:
SP Skills aren't activating.
Place a Scorer in the "SP" position in the lane info.
data.live_tip-not_possessed-02|description:
SP Skills aren't activating. In the "SP"
position in the lane info, place an Idol that has an SP Skill.
data.live_tip-other-01|description:
Lane colors indicate Vocal, Dance, and Visual.
Match your Accessories and Photos to the corresponding colors in your formation.
data.live_tip-other-02|description:
It seems your Idols' levels aren't high enough for the Live difficulty.
If you're short on Lesson Pieces, buy them at the Market.
data.live_tip-skill_heavy_weight-01|descripti:
This Live gives a bonus to the Score earned from A Skills.
Use "A Skill Score Up" to boost the effect of A Skills.
data.live_tip-skill_heavy_weight-02|descripti:
This Live gives a bonus to the Score earned from A Skills.
Arrange your formation so enhancement effects activate right before A Skills.
data.live_tip-stamina_shortage-01|description:
It seems Skills aren't activating due to insufficient Stamina.
Compensate for Stamina with Sub Accessories and Photos.
data.live_tip-stamina_shortage-02|description:
It seems Skills aren't activating due to insufficient Stamina.
Form a unit with an Idol that has a Stamina recovery Skill.
